title: Soul Feast #56: What’s Real? What Should I Do Now?
excerpt: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world.
bodyHtml:
Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE.

A new consciousness is reshaping the human experience – and this Soul Feast of The Gary Zukav Deepcast invites you to step consciously into it. In What’s Real? What Should I Do Now? Gary explores the dramatic tension between the fading five-sensory world – built on manipulation, control, and fear – and the emerging multi-sensory world founded on love, cooperation, and reverence for life. He illustrates how today’s global crises mirror an inner crossroads each of us faces: will we cling to external power, or choose authentic power instead?

As Gary unpacks the illusions of fear-based living, he reveals how every act of anger, righteousness, or superiority reinforces the old consciousness, while every act of compassion builds the new. Through examples ranging from authoritarian politics to our most intimate relationships, he shows that transforming the world begins by transforming the self.

In the end, the path forward is disarmingly simple yet profoundly challenging: choose love over fear. By doing so, you align your personality with your soul – the true source of real power and the only force capable of changing the world.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:45) — The urgent question of “What’s real?” amid global turmoil, AI, and climate change
  • (03:19) — How two worlds – old and new consciousness – exist side by side
  • (08:57) — The illusion of separation between “in here” and “out there”
  • (12:44) — Why every choice is between love and fear—and how to see the parts of your personality that drive each
  • (15:54) — What it means to live as a “chooser” in the Earth School
  • (17:43) — How to respond to fear-based leaders and systems without losing your humanity
  • (22:41) — Why authentic power, not external power, is the only force that truly transforms the world

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take out your Soul Notebook and reflect on the moments in this Soul Feast that stirred something in you – agreement, resistance, or curiosity. Which ideas felt true? Which challenged you? Write honestly about how you relate to fear and love in your daily choices. Each reflection deepens your awareness of what is real in your own life and strengthens your ability to create authentic power.
